page_title: BOL 3-3 JUV | Bologna v Juventus 20/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but the ball is blocked by one of his teammates.
90+3' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giovanni Ayroldi had an easy-decision to make.

89' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his shot flies just over the crossbar. This should be a big warning for the defence.
89' The referee blows his whistle, Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
88' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.

84' 3 - 3 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner of the net.
83' 3 - 2 Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) curls the ball over the defensive wall via a free kick and it flies into the top left corner of the net. What a brilliant technique!
83' We are about to witness a very dangerous free kick from the edge of the box! Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) will be the one to show us his shooting technique.
82' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Michel Aebischer (Bologna) for his blatant foul.
80' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.

76' 3 - 1 Goal! Federico Chiesa (Juventus) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Lukasz Skorupski is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 3:1.
76' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Remo Freuler is replaced by Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna).
75' Thiago Motta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sam Beukema (Bologna) replacing Riccardo Calafiori.
74' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 9:4.
71' It will be a substitution. Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) is ready to enter the pitch as Adrien Rabiot walks off.
70' It's time for a substitution. Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) comes on in place of Kacper Urbanski.
70' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) replaces Jens Odgaard.
68' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bremer (Juventus) was quite harsh and Giovanni Ayroldi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
65' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Juventus, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
64' Substitution. Dusan Vlahovic is replaced by Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus).
63' Thiago Motta has decided to substitute Santiago Castro and he is replaced by Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna).
62' Tempers flare after Danilo (Juventus) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
59' 66:34 – the latest ball possession ratio.
57' Here's the change. Federico Gatti leaves the pitch and Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) comes on as a substitute.
53' 3 - 0 What a goal that is! Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) gets to the ball inside the box and brilliantly lifts the ball over Wojciech Szczesny and into the net. 3:0.
50' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) commits a rough foul. Giovanni Ayroldi stops the game and makes a call.
47' A cross from a corner kick by Juventus is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

47' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Lukasz Skorupski shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
46' Paolo Montero makes a half-time substitution. Carlos Alcaraz comes on in place of Fabio Miretti (Juventus).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is replaced by Timothy Weah.
46' The whistle blows and Giovanni Ayroldi starts the second half.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
44' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
42' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
42' Giovanni Ayroldi blows for a foul after Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
39' Bologna are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
38' The linesman signals that Jens Odgaard (Bologna) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
38' The ball is cleared after Jens Odgaard (Bologna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
34' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
33' 68:32 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
32' Juventus are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
32' One of the Bologna players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
29' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) will miss the next game.
29' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) has tested the patience of referee Giovanni Ayroldi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
27' Bologna have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
26' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) is very lucky to stay on the pitch after using excessive force to bring down his opponent with a two-footed challenge.
24' Giovanni Ayroldi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Federico Gatti (Juventus).
22' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
21' The Juventus players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
20' Rough tackle by Bremer (Juventus). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' 6:0 – the total goal attempt statistics.
18' Bologna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
17' Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block. It will be a corner kick for Bologna.
17' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) trips an opposition player and Giovanni Ayroldi signals a foul.
15' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Jens Odgaard (Bologna) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
11' 2 - 0 Goal! Santiago Castro (Bologna) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Kacper Urbanski and easily beat the keeper with a header into the roof of the net from close range. 2:0.
9' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bologna.
8' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wojciech Szczesny intercepts the ball.
6' Bologna enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
2' 1 - 0 Goal! Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) fires the rebound into the top left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
2' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bologna.
2' Remo Freuler (Bologna) quickly picks up the rebound and shoots towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save to deny him.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Juventus will have the kick-off.
Giovanni Ayroldi got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
